column1: # Muse Glimmer-30B tensor families — the checkpoint's own index, not a transliteration.
# THAT INDEX IS VENDORED BESIDE THIS FILE (2026-08-11) and is the ground truth, not this.
# `tests/glimmer_names.rs` derives the families and counts below from it and diffs, so the
# numbers on the two lines above are provenance rather than the thing being checked — and a
# family this reduction never mentions can no longer hide, which is what they could not catch.
# Re-reduce by re-deriving from the vendored index; do not hand-edit a row.
# Fetched 2026-08-11. dtype/shape are the SHARD HEADERS' own, read by HTTP Range
# (8-byte LE length, then that many bytes) — not the index's, which carries neither.
# Families are names with `.layers.<n>.` -> `.layers.{L}.`. That rule is stated because
# the count depends on it: 40 families total, of which the text side is what this
# port implements and `model.vision_*` is out of scope.
